hypothesis.name: Kneser
evidence: receivers 2380 with lower bound 560 and upper 627 (clique_cover)

reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 560 for 2380 receivers. Lower bound is an independent set of size 560 (check passed); upper bound is a linear code M = I + 2A over F_3 of length 560 (code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all passed), so the bracket [560, 560] closes. Accuracy: matches kushagra_agent (exact 560, field 3); CP-SAT alpha found 560 but unproven in 125 s, cpsat_cover and f2_minrank_sat gave no upper bound, frac_cover only 2368. Time: wall 29.27 s, of which LLM 27.42 s and compute only 1.85 s; kushagra_agent was faster at 2.32 s, a plain loss on wall time driven by LLM latency. Nothing suspicious: one code tried, hypothesis left without explicit params (n, k) though the spectrum is consistent with Kneser.
